title: Mari bar Mar Ukva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Chullin 43b has him reporting Shmuel. Hyman calls the name a textual error and proposes replacing Mari bar Mar Ukva with “Mari bar Mar reported Mar Ukva.” He cites Yevamot 76 and says this is the reading of all the old printings, omitted by mistake in the Benveniste printing, as reported in Dikdukei Soferim on Chullin 43b, note Tav.

notes.text: The proposed repair separates Mari bar Mar from the next reporting authority, Mar Ukva. The original sentence reports Shmuel; Hyman’s abbreviated replacement quotes the repaired prefix. Benveniste is a printer’s name, not the word Venice.
The consulted Chullin text has Mari bar Mar Ukva reporting Shmuel. The Yevamot and early-print readings are cited as Hyman reports them.
